title: Quiet servers
clear: No server has been quiet for {days} days or more. All {total} servers are using the bot.
summary: **{n}** of {total} servers have not used the bot for **{days}+ days** ({members} members in total).
pick: Pick a server to look at
note: Quiet means no command, button or member join in that time. Your home server is never listed.
askOne: Do you want ARCHON to leave this server?
sureAllBody: ARCHON will leave the {n} servers quiet for {days}+ days ({members} members). It can only come back if someone invites it again.
nowActive: This server is active again, so ARCHON stayed.
busy: Already leaving servers, give it a moment.
ownerOnly: This command is only for the bot owner.
dmClosed: I couldn't send you a DM. Open your DMs or use /ghostclean.
activeSummary: **{n}** of {total} servers used the bot in the last {days} days.
